title: Supervisor dashboard: show crashed/aborted/force-released sprints that have no terminal state file
body: The Finished Sprints list (apra-fleet-i9ag.4) only lists runs with a persisted old_runs/ terminal state, so every History link resolves. A sprint that crashed, was aborted-by-restart or was force-released without a terminal state still disappears from the dashboard after its reservation is released. Show those from sprint-history.json events with an 'unknown' verdict and a raw-log link instead of a History link.

Acceptance test test/i9ag4-dashboard-finished-sprints.test.mjs passes (7/7), as do all supervisor dashboard/history/backlog/launch-form suites. Full npm test exit=1, but only on failures outside the diff and caused by the environment: serve-wiring-integration and spawner orphan-survival (both reproduced on the untouched v0.5_dashboard base in this container), shell-ui suites (ui-kit package entry not built in this clone), and bd/docker/kill tests (no bd binary, no docker). Not closing: the AC requires npm test green, and that needs the 3-OS CI run on the PR. Close once CI is green.
